products.description:

products.name: Chile 2026 Away Jersey
products.description:

The design is finished with a shield motif taken from the Federation crest across the back of the neck in black.

products.name: Portugal Vintage Classic Jersey
products.description:
This Portugal Classic jersey carries a clean, classic elegance with a bold touch of identity. The base is a crisp white, giving it a timeless and premium look, while the horizontal band across the chest blends deep red and dark green—colors strongly associated with passion, pride, and heritage.

At the center-left sits a refined portugal crest, symbolizing tradition and national pride, while the number 7 on the right adds a sense of individuality and legacy—often worn by iconic players. The collar design enhances its vintage football aesthetic, making it feel both retro and modern at the same time.

products.name: Barcelona Vintage Classic Jersey
products.description:
This Barcelona vintage classic jersey captures the essence of timeless football heritage with effortless style. The deep navy and rich maroon vertical stripes instantly evoke tradition, symbolizing decades of passion, dominance, and identity.

The clean collar design adds a retro charm, giving it that old-school football elegance that feels both authentic and iconic. The subtle “estd. 1899” detail proudly nods to the club’s historic roots, while the crest stands strong—representing pride, unity, and legacy.

At the center, the bold “Cule” script brings a modern emotional touch, connecting fans to the soul of the club. The long sleeves enhance its classic appeal, making it feel like a piece straight out of football’s golden era.
